source: Williamson Tea Kenya Plc unaudited consolidated results for the six months ended 30 September 2026, reported 12 November 2026. Printed figures in KES: revenue 2.11 billion (up 24.8 per cent), operating profit before tax 260.5 million (from a loss of 111.6 million), fair value gains on biological assets 56.9 million (up 25.2 per cent), profit before tax 396.2 million (from a loss of 23.6 million), profit after tax 284.1 million (from a loss of 8.8 million), earnings per share 7.97 (from a loss of 0.27). Balance sheet: total assets 12.32 billion, shareholders equity 9.75 billion, cash and bank balances 779.4 million. Operating cash flow 361.3 million and dividends paid 494.8 million. Coverage: Business Daily, Business Today and The Kenyan Wallstreet, 12 November 2026. The operating profit line plus the fair value gain does not equal the printed profit before tax; the 78.8 million difference is other income the coverage does not break out, so that cell is left blank.
